text: I am an Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in the Department of Economic Analysis at the University of Valencia (UV). I am also a member of the Behavioral, Experimental, and Evolutionary (BEE) research group.
html: I am an Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in the Department of Economic Analysis at the University of Valencia (UV). I am also a member of the Behavioral, Experimental, and Evolutionary (BEE) research group.

text: My main research interests are Behavioral and Experimental Economics, (Evolutionary) Game Theory, and Neuroeconomics. I am currently working on the topics of dishonesty, punishment, social norms, and strategic sophistication. In particular, I analyze the determinants of deception by creating methods to discriminate between false and true information and study the drivers of dishonesty and sanctions for communication. Besides, I study the evolution of conventions (i.e., long-run equilibria) in uncertain environments.

text: I completed my Ph.D. in June 2026 at IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca (Economics, Networks and Business Analytics) and the University of Alicante (Economics), supervised by Ennio Bilancini and Carlos Cueva. Prior to my doctoral studies, I got a Master's degree in Quantitative Economics (Universidad de Alicante) and a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics (Universidad de Alicante).
